atoms.text: Haikus are poems with a syllable pattern. The first line must have 5 syllables, the second line 7 syllables and the third line must have 5 syllables again.

example.a:
Just remember the syllable structure of a haiku:
5-7-5.

b.sound: A unit of sound that breaks apart words.
A comma that connects words together.

example.a:
For Carmen
by Emma

I discovered love
Butterflies in my stomach—
A smile on my face.
